coordinate_system: Metres. X increases east-northeast along the south elevation (approximate true bearing 73 degrees). Y increases into the historic hall. Y=0 is the main high south wall separated from its projecting porch.
front_fringes: The 1934 oblique view shows six pierced or incised vertical piers, four glazed central windows, a narrow diagonal upper frieze, four shallower side panels and ribbed horizontal mouldings. In 2020 the central upper surface visible between trees carries triangular motifs. Certain lower side fields are screened by foliage.
historic_register: The 1934 PastVu record locates an approximate camera. The dated school-alumni photograph independently places the south entrance opposite Longmen Building.
authoring_limits: Absolute geometry is estimated using photo perspective and an approximately 31–32m front rim from several aerial acquisitions. The coarse source polygon measures about 36.4 by 55.6m. Roof height, pitch and hidden surfaces are unmeasured. Northern connected buildings have separate footprints and are not assigned a 1934 date.
